title: Verification check runner
responsibility: Runs a planned check or declared tool in the snapshot under resource admission and process isolation, gathers bounded evidence, and returns its result.

inputs.name: CheckRunService.constructor.context
inputs.description: Run metadata, snapshot and scratch directories, environment, and optional capture byte limits.

inputs.name: CheckRunService.run.check
inputs.description: Planned check to execute with its runner, target, cwd, command and timeout.

inputs.name: CheckRunService.version.tool
inputs.description: Declared tool ID and command whose first nonempty output line identifies its version.

outputs.name: CheckRunService.run
outputs.description: Outcome with the check entry, pass/fail state, admitted captures, and capture or execution failures.

outputs.name: CheckRunService.version
outputs.description: First nonempty output line on success, or undefined when the command does not complete successfully or prints no version.
